plugins.name: quantset
plugins.description: Put the global stock market inside your agent. Ask "Which fast-growing companies still trade under 15x free cash flow?" or "How much of my portfolio is secretly one stock?" and get real numbers with sources. 90,000+ symbols and 52,000+ stocks across 67 countries, 734 crypto pairs, 42 currencies, financials for 36,000+ companies, 127M+ SEC filing facts, 4,899 ETFs you can look through, analyst estimates and a 40-factor screener. Includes DCF, comps and screening skills. 250 free credits on signup, no card.
